description: This file contains code for a rich text editor using Quill, with functions to convert between Markdown and Quill Delta formats, and to generate an MDAST (Markdown Abstract Syntax Tree) from Delta. It also initializes editors on page load and handles form submission to sync Markdown content.

methods.name: deltaToMarkdown
methods.description: Converts a Quill Delta object to a Markdown string using mdast.

methods.name: createAndReplaceTextarea
methods.description: Creates a div to replace a textarea and prepares it for Quill.

methods.name: getMarkdownToolbarOptions
methods.description: Returns the toolbar options array configured for Markdown compatibility.

methods.name: initializeQuillEditor
methods.description: Initializes a Quill editor instance on a given div with specified options.

methods.name: markdownToDelta
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to a Quill Delta object.

methods.name: mdastToDelta
methods.description: Converts an MDAST to a Quill Delta.

methods.name: traverseMdastNode
methods.description: Recursively traverses MDAST nodes and converts to Delta operations.

methods.name: updateTextareaOnSubmit
methods.description: Attaches a submit event listener to update the hidden textarea with Markdown content.

methods.name: loadQuillStylesheet
methods.description: Loads the Quill CSS stylesheet.

methods.name: handleEditorInitError
methods.description: Handles errors during editor initialization.

methods.name: setupSingleEditor
methods.description: Sets up a Quill editor for a specific textarea.

methods.name: initializeEditors
methods.description: Initializes Quill editors for all textareas on page load.

methods.name: deltaToMdast
methods.description: Converts a Quill Delta to an MDAST (Markdown Abstract Syntax Tree).

methods.name: createRootNode
methods.description: Creates a root MDAST node.

methods.name: createParagraphNode
methods.description: Creates a paragraph MDAST node.

methods.name: isImageInsert
methods.description: Checks if an operation is an image insertion.

methods.name: createImageNode
methods.description: Creates an image MDAST node.

methods.name: createTextNodes
methods.description: Creates text MDAST nodes with optional formatting.

methods.name: wrapNodesWith
methods.description: Wraps nodes with a formatting container.

methods.name: processLineBreak
methods.description: Processes a line break in the Delta, converting to appropriate MDAST nodes.

methods.name: handleEmptyLineWithAttributes
methods.description: Handles empty lines with special attributes during Delta to MDAST conversion.

methods.name: createEmptyCodeBlock
methods.description: Creates an empty code block node.

methods.name: createEmptyListItem
methods.description: Creates an empty list item node.

methods.name: createEmptyBlockquote
methods.description: Creates an empty blockquote node.

methods.name: processHeaderLineBreak
methods.description: Processes header line breaks during Delta to MDAST conversion.

methods.name: processCodeBlockLineBreak
methods.description: Processes code block line breaks during Delta to MDAST conversion.

methods.name: ensureList
methods.description: Ensures a list exists in the MDAST for list items.

methods.name: processListLineBreak
methods.description: Processes list line breaks, adding list items to the list.

methods.name: processBlockquoteLineBreak
methods.description: Processes blockquote line breaks, avoiding duplication.
